name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport finance began unexpectedly. Initially working as a chartered accountant for a multinational corporation, he found himself drawn to the strategic financial decisions that underpinned successful racing teams. A chance encounter with a local racing team owner led to a consulting role, and he quickly realized his passion lay in navigating the complex finances of motorsport. 

Wei Liang's approach to financial control is meticulous and proactive. He believes in fostering transparency and collaboration between the technical and commercial sides of the team. At Meyer Shank Racing, he is known for his calm demeanor and ability to find innovative financial solutions to optimize performance. He prides himself on ensuring every dollar spent contributes to on-track success, balancing ambition with fiscal responsibility. 

His unique blend of financial acumen and motorsport understanding has made him a valuable asset to several racing teams. He is not only a finance controller, but also a strategic partner who helps the team achieve its goals.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a lucky abacus in his briefcase.
Insists on having a cup of jasmine tea before reviewing financial reports.
Secretly collects miniature model race cars.
